Thanks for sharing! Keep this short — the files speak for themselves.
提示：一个 PR 只做一件事；更新已有工作流时保持 slug 不变并把 version 加一。
-->

## What is this PR?

- [ ] New workflow (`workflows/<slug>/` did not exist)
- [ ] Update to an existing workflow (`slug` unchanged, `version` bumped)
- [ ] Removal (directory deleted, reason below)
- [ ] Docs / metadata fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `meta.json` is valid (schema `1`) and matches the committed files
- [ ] `meta.json.hash` equals the SHA-256 of `workflow.json`
- [ ] Images are WebP, at most 3, ≤ 1 MB each; video is an external `videoUrl` only
- [ ] No tokens, passwords, cookies, personal data, run logs, or screenshots
- [ ] The workflow is triggered manually and does not depend on a hidden signed-in state

<!-- Anything the reviewer should know: what the workflow does, which page it targets, why it changed. -->
